question: Deepak sold a bike to Sharath at a profit of 40%. Sharath sold his bike to Sivaji at a loss of 30%. If Deepak paid ₹8,000 for this bike, then find the cost price of the bike for Sivaji.
solution:

Cost price of the bike for Deepak = ₹8,000

Loss incurred by Sharath = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit%)

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 - Loss%)
